subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: Should this onboarding phase ship with OpenClaw pinned only for fresh profiles while existing saved pin sets remain untouched and the route is discoverable through More/customize?
rationale: The branch intentionally preserves stored preferences rather than migrating the historical default; that is a user-facing navigation-default choice that code review cannot resolve from tests alone.

options.title: Preserve saved pin sets
options.body: Approve fresh-profile pinning while leaving every existing persisted pin list unchanged, with More/customize as the upgrade discovery path.

options.title: Promote the old default
options.body: Add a narrowly defined migration or promotion path for profiles still carrying the exact historical default list, with tests proving customized lists remain untouched.

options.title: Defer the navigation change
options.body: Pause this phase until the desired upgrade discovery and permanent-caretaker interaction model are agreed.

recommendation.title: Preserve saved pin sets
recommendation.body: Approve fresh-profile pinning while leaving every existing persisted pin list unchanged, with More/customize as the upgrade discovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged custodian onboarding foundation and this branch’s navigation-default design are both connected to this feature history.
